##Figure out composition
```{r}
composition2 <- composition
composition2$c_w1 <- composition$id_c
```

### Wave 1

```{r}
#Only wave 1
w1 <- droplevels(subset(survey, wave == 1))
#Now only friendships
w1_soc <- dplyr::select(w1, c(id_p, a1_0101:a1_0110))
head(w1_soc)
w1_soc$id_p <- as.factor(w1_soc$id_p)
#To long format
w1soclong <- reshape(data = w1_soc, direction = "long"
  , timevar = "nomination1:10"
  , times = names(w1_soc)[2:11] 
  , idvar = "id_p"
  , v.names = "receiver"
  , varying = 2:11
  , new.row.names = 1:870
  )
#Only sender + receiver. Then I'll have an edge list
w1edgelist <- dplyr::select(w1soclong, c(id_p, receiver))
w1edgelist$receiver <- as.character(w1edgelist$receiver)
w1edgelist$id_p <- as.character(w1edgelist$id_p)
head(w1edgelist)
summary(w1edgelist)
w1edgelistnona <- droplevels(w1edgelist[-which(is.na(w1edgelist$receiver) == TRUE),]) #removing the unused nomination opportunities
summary(w1edgelistnona)
```
```{r}
require(igraph)
w1graph <- graph_from_data_frame(w1edgelistnona)
w1adjmat <- as_adjacency_matrix(w1graph)
plot(w1graph)
```
```{r}
#plot wave 1
colournative <- ifelse(w1$native==1, "white", "purple") #white is native
shapenative <- ifelse(w1$native==1, "circle", "square") #circle is native
shapegender <- ifelse(is.na(w1$ed_a6), "csquare", ifelse(w1$ed_a6==1, "circle", "square")) #circle is girl?
colourclass <- ifelse(is.na(w1$id_c), "gray", ifelse(w1$id_c==1, "thistle", ifelse(w1$id_c==2, "skyblue1", "aquamarine")))
rangewarm <- colorRampPalette(c("grey91", "grey50", "grey30", "black"))
nbins <- 5
colourbetweenness <- rangewarm(nbins)

V(w1graph)$size = igraph::betweenness(w1graph, normalized = T, directed = T)*50 + 5

plot(w1graph,
     vertex.color = adjustcolor(colournative, alpha.f = .4),
     vertex.frame.color = adjustcolor(colourclass),
     vertex.frame.width = 2,
     vertex.label = NA,
     edge.curved = 0.2, # curved edges is always a nice touch
     edge.arrow.size = 0.3,
     edge.color = colourbetweenness[cut(igraph::edge_betweenness(w1graph), breaks=nbins )],
     layout = layout.fruchterman.reingold, 
     main = "Wave 1")

```
